title: MINX
tagline: IP Protection and Social Collaboration for Content Creators - Just MINX It !
description: MINX provides content creators with the ability to publish their content via web3 protocols and protect their IP. It also provides the ability to collaborate with co-creators and other tech-solution providers such as those who could provide IFPS and minting support (crypto) to a project. This is packaged in a social environmet with Instagram-like UX for minimum learning effort.
how_its_made: This is made with reactjs (+nextjs version to follow) with IPFS as the primary solution for content hosting and sharing. a backend services from mongo-db is used for off-chain indexing and the application is hosted via Spheron. The token contract is hosted on Polygon Mumbai testnet.
